usage: 日本 (jat6 bun2) is used as a noun to refer to the country Japan.
You can use 日本 when talking about travel plans, geography, or cultural topics related to Japan.
In Cantonese sentences, 日本 usually comes before verbs or other nouns, for example, 日本餐 means Japanese food.
It can stand alone or combine with other words to form compound nouns like 日本人 (Japanese person).
